title: Dungourney, Midleton, Co. Cork
description:
10-15 minute drive to Midleton, 20 minutes Little Island, 30 minutes to Dunkettle roundabout / tunnel Cork and 40 minutes to Cork Airport. 

A lovely renovated  furnished 4 bed spacious south facing Farm House with garden in a lovely rural setting. 

Services apply to this property.

References are essential.
